query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages s JOIN public.books b ON b.id=s.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND s.source_page BETWEEN 759 AND 763),'topics',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics t JOIN public.chapters c ON c.id=t.chapter_id JOIN public.books b ON b.id=c.book_id WHERE b.title='Jubayer''s GK' AND c.slug='europe' AND t.slug IN ('bimstec-bcim-boundary-759','g7-g20-boundary-760','g77-d8-seaco-boundary-761','benelux-usmca-mercosur-comesa-boundary-762','acu-eco-development-banks-boundary-763')),'facts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 759 AND 763),'notes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 759 AND 763),'mcqs',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 759 AND 763),'mcq_options',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcq_options o JOIN public.gk_mcqs m ON m.id=o.mcq_id WHERE m.source_page BETWEEN 759 AND 763),'verifications',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 759 AND 763),'flashcards',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0759-0763:%'),'search_documents',0) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
